title: m10-ms-cap-discovery-followup-2
summary: Refactor crates/chronos-mcp/src/server.rs to derive tool list assertions from the live #[tool_router] registration (ChronosServer::tool_router().list_all()) instead of a hand-maintained REGISTERED_TOOLS mirror. Single file, +71/-97 lines. Closes the parallel-list drift risk identified by the original MS-CAP-DISCOVERY-FOLLOWUP-2 candidate.

findings.title: rmcp 1.5 ToolRouter::list_all() exposes the live tool list
evidence: Probe test in tests/test_router_list_all.rs confirmed: 61 tools returned, names match REGISTERED_TOOLS exactly

findings.title: REGISTERED_TOOLS mirror constant deleted
evidence: 61-line hand-maintained mirror in toolset_sync_check module deleted

findings.title: all_tool_names_matches_router set-equality test added
evidence: Test compares ALL_TOOL_NAMES set vs router.list_all() set; failure message lists missing/extra entries

findings.title: tool_router() promoted to public via #[rmcp::tool_router(vis = "pub")]
evidence: Allows ChronosServer::tool_router() to be called from outside the impl block (test modules, future external tooling)

findings.title: router_has_expected_minimum_tool_count tripwire test added (>= 50)
evidence: Catches accidental bulk deletion of #[tool] registrations
